body:
ok this one lives in my head rent-free 🏰

when it came time to shoot the "love story" video, taylor assumed the whole team would have to fly to europe — because obviously a fairy-tale needs a real castle, and castles aren't just... sitting around in tennessee.

except one is. castle gwynn, a genuine turreted castle in arrington, about a half hour from nashville, the kind of place that hosts the state's renaissance festival. "i just didn't think that castles were in tennessee at all," she admitted — and then went and filmed one of her most iconic videos basically down the road from home.

the whole fearless era, from that castle to the gold fringe on the eras stage: longlivets.com/?era=fearless&utm_source=instagram&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=era-deep-cut
